description: a plate 10 x 10 x 2 with a hole of radius 1 through it at (5, 8.2), and a boss of radius 2 and height 2 on its top at (5, 5), the boss's root circle filleted at r 0.6. The concave ring's contact on the plate's top, a circle of radius 2.6 about the boss's axis, runs into the hole's rim, a circle of radius 1 whose edge is not the blend's own: the two circles meet in two points, the ball rolling on the rim between them: a rational patch from the boss's contact down to the rim, as for a plate's outer edge (blend/standoff-root-fillet-runs-off-the-plate), the torus left either side of it. Arris keeps the torus one face open at the rolled face, and the hole's loop joins the top's contact loop

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE splits the ring's torus in two, either side of the rolled patch, joined by an edge at the seam; Arris keeps the torus one face open at the rolled face, its seam inside it (ADR-0071 §2)
